items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: Old friend of mine. I says, 'I'm all right. He took a card out of his pocket and wrote on his card to give me 100 marks...'

ctx.x: Norman Thomas of the Norman Thomas Quintet, played right here in America, old team I knew and the boy who played drums for him is in Switzerland now.

He's dead now, Norman is, God rest his soul. So I don't take the card to the office now. I just go on to the hotel, this is in the evening, I just left the office, I just go on to the hotel -- where this guy got me a room, it weren't no hotel, it was a private house. Like the roomers stay? I went to this place and time to go to bed almost. I don't want to go nowhere so I go to bed. The phone call ringing is what woke me up the next morning. It was the office that this guy was out of. I forget her name, but out of…
